page.metaTitle: SEC Filing Alerts & EDGAR Monitoring | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track SEC filings on EDGAR with automated alerts. Catch 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 13F, and S-1 submissions for any company with checks as often as every 30 minutes.
page.h1: SEC filing alerts and EDGAR monitoring
page.subtitle: Track new filings for any public company. Catch 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, 13F-HR position disclosures, and S-1 IPO filings without refreshing EDGAR yourself.
page.intro: WebMonitor.fyi watches the SEC EDGAR system and company filing pages for new submissions. The SEC filing alerts fire on the schedule you pick — every 30 minutes during earnings season, six-hourly or daily between cycles. Built for analysts, journalists, retail investors, and compliance teams who want to know about a filing without watching the feed all day.

features.title: Filing-type filtering
features.body: Watch any combination of 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 13F-HR, S-1, Form 4 (insider transactions), Form 144, and proxy filings. Write the criterion to alert on only what matters.

features.title: Company-specific or sector-wide monitoring
features.body: Track a single ticker via its EDGAR filings index, or a whole sector via an EDGAR full-text search URL — each monitor watches one page you choose.

features.title: 30-minute check intervals
features.body: On the Pro plan, checks run as often as every 30 minutes — so you hear about a new filing within half an hour of it posting, without refreshing EDGAR yourself.

features.title: Webhook integration
features.body: Pipe alerts into Slack or any system that accepts a JSON POST — a trading dashboard or a custom risk tool. Each alert carries an AI summary of the new filing activity and a link back to the page.

steps.title: Find the EDGAR URL
steps.body: For a single company: the EDGAR filings index for that CIK. For a sector or filing type: an EDGAR full-text search URL with your filters applied.

steps.title: Set the criterion
steps.body: Examples: "Alert me on any new 8-K from this company." "Notify me when any Form 4 is filed by an insider at companies in my watchlist." "Let me know when a new S-1 is filed by any company in the SaaS sector."

steps.title: Pick a frequency
steps.body: 30-minute checks (Pro) during earnings season; six-hour or daily between.

steps.title: Receive alerts
steps.body: Webhook into Slack is the standard for analyst teams. Email for individual investors.

useCases: Catch earnings 8-Ks within half an hour of posting
Track insider buying and selling via Form 4 filings
Monitor 13F-HR releases for fund position changes
Watch for new S-1 filings in a sector you cover
Catch material event 8-Ks (acquisitions, executive departures, restatements)
Track regulatory comment letters and enforcement filings
page.limits: WebMonitor reads EDGAR's public filing index — the source of truth for SEC filings. We don't aggregate, summarize, or interpret the filing content; that's the analyst's job. For very high-frequency trading use cases (millisecond-grade), specialized direct EDGAR feeds beat web monitoring.

faq.q: How does this compare to EDGAR's own email alerts?
faq.a: EDGAR's built-in email alerts are limited to specific filings and a roughly daily cadence. WebMonitor checks as often as every 30 minutes and supports webhook delivery to Slack or any system that accepts a JSON POST. For analyst teams, the webhook + cadence combination is the main upgrade.

faq.q: Can I track Form 4 insider transactions?
faq.a: Yes. Form 4 is one of the filing types you can filter on. Set up one monitor per company or one monitor against a full-text search URL covering all companies on your watchlist.

faq.q: Does it work for non-US filings (SEDAR, FCA)?
faq.a: WebMonitor watches any publicly accessible filing portal — SEDAR for Canadian filings and the FCA National Storage Mechanism for UK filings both work the same way. Paste the filing index URL and write the criterion.

faq.q: Is this useful for retail investors or only institutions?
faq.a: Both. Retail investors use it for portfolio-level alerts and earnings tracking. Institutions use it for sector-wide coverage, insider monitoring, and webhook integration into existing analyst tooling.

From the filing appearing on EDGAR to the alert arriving in your channel is at most one check interval — about 30 minutes on the Pro plan's fastest cadence. For sub-minute needs, a direct EDGAR feed is the right tool.
